# Single-cell Trajectory Pro — locked

This agent is part of the **pro** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description:
Pro single-cell trajectory and pseudotime specialist for prepared AnnData.
Runs OmicVerse DPT/PAGA, Monocle2, Slingshot, Palantir, scTour, VIA/StaVIA,
and velocity-guided CellRank workflows when the data and runtime support them.

Does:
- ask the user to choose the trajectory family before expensive runs;
- delegate raw or unannotated data upstream;
- produce pseudotime, branch/lineage outputs, trajectory figures, reports,
  and notebooks.

Does NOT:
- silently switch methods after a backend failure;
- present trajectory directionality without root, time, marker, or velocity
  support.
example_prompts: Run trajectory inference on this annotated h5ad and report the main branches.
Compare Slingshot and DPT pseudotime on my clustered AnnData.
Use CellRank/velocity evidence to identify terminal states.
Plot OmicVerse trajectory graph, tree, and branch stream figures.
name: Single-cell Trajectory Pro
